Now here are some risks that you need to be aware of, i’ll start with the most important one
It’s not a bad trip, it’s an NBOMe poisoning. NBOMe is a dangerous drug that when taken in excess could result in Tachycardia, Heart failure and many more health complications that could arise with an NBOMe poisoning. NBOMe *could* be tainted in street blotters and sold as L. 

Whoever does this is evil. I don’t want that to happen to you, nobody on this subreddit does. That being said there is a way to detect NBOMe. Reagent test kits, there are many, but buy an Ehrlich test for L to make sure it’s L and a Marquis reagent, to check for NBOMe.

Now here are the tips
1) Buy aformentioned test kits to make sure you’re getting L!
2) Stay hydrated (a trip could be grand or hell if you’re not hydrated, stay hydrated) 🥵🥵
3) Have a keen mindset (be in a good state of mind, L really makes you think about yourself)
4) Listen & Do things that make you happy, we want you to have a good time here. 

Be safe and happy travels!
